dedupe_keys.name: optimized wind farm layouts for utsira and calabria using pywake and topfarm optimization framework

description: Balram Panjwani publishes two optimised wind-turbine layout CSV files for the Utsira and Calabria case studies. Zenodo serves them under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The MADE4WIND project generated the layouts with a Python workflow using PyWake for wake effects and TopFarm for placement optimisation under minimum-spacing constraints. The deposit says annual energy production guided the search. These coordinates can be starting configurations or comparison cases for wind-farm layout and energy-yield simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these two published layouts. A limitation is that the landing page does not state the turbine specification, coordinate reference system, wind rose or optimisation objective in enough detail to interpret the layouts alone. The two small CSV files were not downloaded, so row count and units were not checked. The reported optimum is conditional on the authors’ chosen assumptions.
